# lamejs 1.2.1

Unmodified `lame.min.js` from the [lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs) npm package (a JavaScript
port of [LAME](https://lame.sourceforge.io/)), licensed LGPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE`). It ships as a separate,
unmodified file and chats.html loads it on demand to turn recorded voice notes into MP3 for WhatsApp.
It is served from here rather than a CDN because the site's Content-Security-Policy only allows 'self'
scripts.
